title: 修復 Viewer 同租戶艦隊讀取被 Registry 角色對照擋成 403

root_cause_analysis.summary: BFF admits `viewer` and `view_only` principals into `_READ_ROLES` and forwards the caller's verified JWT (`Authorization: Bearer <viewer_jwt>`) and `X-Tenant-Id: tenant-dev` to Registry when `GET /bff/management/persona-fleet` computes routed strategy counts via `GET /api/registry/strategy-specs?view=persona_binding_counts`. Registry's `_REGISTRY_READ_ROLES` in `services/registry/service.py` previously allowed only `_REGISTRY_WRITE_ROLES + ("registry-reader",)`, causing strict-mode `_authenticate_registry_read` to reject same-tenant `viewer` and `view_only` principals with HTTP 403 (`Caller roles ('viewer',) do not satisfy required roles ('operator', 'registry-writer', 'admin', 'registry-reader')`), which BFF translated into a 403 `FORBIDDEN` failure on `/bff/management/persona-fleet`.
root_cause_analysis.fix: Extended `_REGISTRY_READ_ROLES` in `services/registry/service.py` to `_REGISTRY_WRITE_ROLES + ("registry-reader", "viewer", "view_only")` while keeping `_REGISTRY_WRITE_ROLES = ("operator", "registry-writer", "admin")` unchanged.

acceptance_criteria_verification.criterion: A genuine locally verified same-tenant viewer and view_only read principal can read the intended scoped Registry GET surfaces including persona_binding, persona_binding_counts, and strategy_summary_page with actual owner data.
The BFF fleet GET works for the same-tenant Viewer principal through the real Registry read contract without empty fallback data or a substituted service or operator token.

Missing or invalid credentials remain denied and cross-tenant selectors and cross-tenant entry reads remain denied while builtin public reads and protected builtin mutations retain the existing policy.
Every Registry mutation still rejects viewer and view_only and no write role list or runtime or broker or capital authority is widened.
Existing operator and admin reads and writes and persona fleet functional data and tenant boundaries do not regress.

Focused strict auth and scoped view tests and BFF integration regression pass and evidence records exact source and commands; final hosted four-profile acceptance remains Human/Ops owned after exact pair delivery.
